translations.literal: Zhen and Xi Zhu went to Guangdong, starting from Fangcheng in Qinzhou, following the coast eastward and north; they passed through seven prefectures, three departments, twenty-nine counties, six garrisons, seventeen posts, sixteen inspection stations, and twenty-one forts and stockades, returning 28,192 qing of land to the people and restoring 31,300 registered persons to their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Xi Zhu began in Guangdong at Fangcheng in Qinzhou and traced the coast east and north through seven prefectures, three subprefectures, twenty-nine counties, six garrisons, seventeen posts, sixteen inspection stations, and twenty-one forts and stockades — restoring 28,192 qing of land and 31,300 registered persons to their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 復如福建，自福寧州西分水關始，遵海以北，歷府四、州一、縣二十四、衛四、所五、巡檢司三、關城鎮砦五十五，還民地二萬一千一十八頃，復業丁口四萬八百。

translations.literal: They then went to Fujian, starting from the Shuifeng Pass west of Funing Prefecture, following the coast north; they passed through four prefectures, one department, twenty-four counties, four garrisons, five posts, three inspection stations, and fifty-five passes, towns, forts, and stockades, returning 21,018 qing of land and restoring 40,800 registered persons.
translations.idiomatic: They then went to Fujian, starting west of Funing at Shuifeng Pass and following the coast north through four prefectures, one subprefecture, twenty-four counties, four garrisons, five posts, three inspection stations, and fifty-five passes, towns, forts, and stockades — restoring 21,018 qing and 40,800 registered persons.

sentences.zh: 於是兩省濱海居民咸得復業。

translations.literal: Thereupon coastal residents of both provinces all were able to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal people in both provinces were thus able to resume their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 別遣使察視江南、浙江展界復業，同時畢事。

translations.literal: Separate envoys were dispatched to inspect the extension of boundaries and restoration of livelihoods in Jiangnan and Zhejiang; all tasks were completed at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Other envoys were sent to inspect boundary extension and resettlement in Jiangnan and Zhejiang; all the work was finished at once.

sentences.zh: 臻以母喪還裡，席柱復命，奏陳濱海居民還鄉安業。

translations.literal: Zhen returned home for his mother's mourning; Xi Zhu reported back, memorializing that coastal residents had returned to their villages and settled into their trades.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen went home to mourn his mother; Xi Zhu returned and reported that coastal residents had gone back to their villages and resumed their trades.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「民樂處海濱，以可出海經商捕魚，爾等知其故，前此何以不准議行？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The people are glad to live on the coast because they can go to sea to trade and fish — you knew this, so why did you not approve and put the proposal into effect before?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "People like living on the coast because they can trade and fish at sea — you knew that. Why did you not approve this before?

sentences.zh: 邊疆大臣當以國計民生為念，曩禁令雖嚴，私出海貿易初未嘗斷絕。

translations.literal: Frontier ministers must keep the national interest and the people's livelihood in mind; though the old prohibitions were strict, private overseas trade never truly ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier ministers must think of the national interest and the people's livelihood. However strict the old bans, private overseas trade never really stopped.

sentences.zh: 凡議出海貿易不可行者，皆總督、巡撫自圖射利故也。

translations.literal: Whenever anyone argues that overseas trade must not be allowed, it is because governors and governors-general seek profit for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever anyone says overseas trade must be forbidden, it is because governors and governors-general are lining their own pockets.

sentences.zh: 臻喪終，起刑部尚書。

translations.literal: When his mourning ended, he was recalled as minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended, he was recalled as minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 舊制，方冬獄囚月給煤，獄吏率乾沒，囚多以寒疾死，臻力禁之。

translations.literal: Under the old system, in winter prisoners received monthly coal rations, but jailers routinely embezzled them, and many prisoners died of cold-related illness; Zhen vigorously forbade this.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, prisoners received monthly coal in winter, but jailers routinely stole it and many died of cold; Zhen forbade this firmly.

sentences.zh: 調兵部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 時議裁各省駐防及督、撫、提、鎮標兵，臻謂：「兵冗可裁而不宜驟行，請自今老弱、物故、額缺概不補，數歲額自減。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of cutting garrison troops in each province and the banner troops of governors, governors-general, circuit intendants, and brigade commanders; Zhen said: "Redundant troops may be cut, but it should not be done abruptly; from now on let none of the old, weak, deceased, or vacant posts be filled — in a few years the quotas will shrink of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated cutting provincial garrisons and the banner detachments of governors, governors-general, circuit intendants, and brigade commanders, Zhen argued, "Redundant troops can be cut, but not all at once — from now on do not fill posts left by the old, weak, dead, or vacant; in a few years the rolls will shrink on their own.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 再調禮部。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 以疾告歸，尋卒於家。

translations.literal: He requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home; soon afterward he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He asked leave on grounds of illness and went home; he died there soon after.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，書「眷懷舊德」額追賜之。

translations.literal: When the emperor toured the south, he wrote and posthumously bestowed the plaque reading "Cherishing an old worthy."
translations.idiomatic: On a southern tour the emperor wrote and posthumously bestowed a plaque reading "Cherishing an old worthy."

sentences.zh: 臻少貧力學，事祖母及父母孝，宏獎人才，詩文剴切中條理。

translations.literal: Zhen was poor in youth but studied hard; he served his grandmother and parents with filial devotion, encouraged talent broadly, and his prose and poetry were incisive and to the point.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was poor as a youth but studied hard, served his grandmother and parents filially, encouraged talent generously, and wrote prose and verse that cut cleanly to the point.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈，吳雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sa Muha, of the Wuya clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha, of the Wuya clan, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年進士，授戶部主事，遷員外郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Revenue, and was promoted to assistant department director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Shunzhi 12, was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Revenue, and rose to assistant department director.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，聖祖允吳三桂疏請撤籓，遣薩穆哈偕郎中黨務禮、席蘭泰，主事辛珠，筆帖式薩爾圖如貴州，具舟及芻粟，諭以毋騷擾，毋遲悮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, the Sage Ancestor acceded to Wu Sangui's memorial requesting withdrawal of the fief, and dispatched Sa Muha together with department director Dang Wuli and Xilan Tai, principal clerk Xin Zhu, and clerk Sa'ertu to Guizhou, furnishing boats and fodder and instructing them to cause no disturbance and suffer no delay.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 12 the emperor granted Wu Sangui's request to withdraw his fief and sent Sa Muha with Department Director Dang Wuli, Xilan Tai, Principal Clerk Xin Zhu, and Clerk Sa'ertu to Guizhou, supplying boats and fodder and ordering them to cause no disturbance and suffer no delay.

sentences.zh: 既至，三桂謀反，提督李本深與謀，書招貴州巡撫曹申吉，總督甘文焜得之，告薩穆哈等，趣詣京師告變，並請兵赴援。

translations.literal: Upon arrival, Sangui plotted rebellion; Regional Commander Li Benshen joined the plot and wrote to summon Guizhou Governor Cao Shenji; Governor-General Gan Wenkun learned of it, informed Sa Muha and the others, and urged them to hurry to the capital to report the mutiny and also request troops for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival they found Sangui plotting rebellion; Regional Commander Li Benshen joined him and wrote to summon Guizhou Governor Cao Shenji. Governor-General Gan Wenkun learned of it, told Sa Muha and the others, and urged them to race to the capital to report the mutiny and request troops.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈與黨務禮、席蘭泰行至鎮遠，三桂已舉兵，鎮遠將吏得三桂檄，不給驛馬。

translations.literal: Sa Muha, Dang Wuli, and Xilan Tai reached Zhenyuan; Sangui had already raised troops, and the officers of Zhenyuan, having received Sangui's proclamation, refused post horses.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha, Dang Wuli, and Xilan Tai reached Zhenyuan after Sangui had already risen; the local officers, having received his proclamation, refused them post horses.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈、黨務禮得馬二，馳至沅州。

translations.literal: Sa Muha and Dang Wuli obtained two horses and raced to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha and Dang Wuli secured two horses and galloped to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乃乘驛，十一晝夜至京師，詣兵部，下馬喘急，抱柱不能言，久之始蘇，上三桂反狀。

translations.literal: Then by relay post they reached the capital in eleven days and nights; they went to the Board of War, dismounted gasping for breath, clutched a pillar unable to speak, and only after a long while recovered and reported Sangui's rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: By relay they reached the capital in eleven days and nights, went straight to the Board of War, dismounted gasping, clutched a pillar speechless, and only after a long while recovered enough to report Sangui's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 席蘭泰自鎮遠乘小舟至常德，乃乘驛，後七日至。

translations.literal: Xilan Tai went from Zhenyuan by small boat to Changde, then by relay — arriving seven days later.
translations.idiomatic: Xilan Tai left Zhenyuan by small boat for Changde, then by relay — arriving seven days later.

sentences.zh: 辛珠、薩爾圖不及行，死之。

translations.literal: Xin Zhu and Sa'ertu could not get away in time and died.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Zhu and Sa'ertu could not escape in time and were killed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢薩穆哈刑部郎中。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Sa Muha was promoted to director in the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Sa Muha was promoted to director in the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十四年，敘告變功，薩穆哈、黨務禮、席蘭泰並應升光祿、太僕諸卿。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, in recognition of reporting the mutiny, Sa Muha, Dang Wuli, and Xilan Tai were all eligible for promotion to the rank of director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Minister of the Imperial Stud, and similar posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, for reporting the mutiny, Sa Muha, Dang Wuli, and Xilan Tai were all eligible for promotion to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, minister of the imperial stud, and comparable posts.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was appointed director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 十六年，再遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was again promoted to vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was again promoted to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 命監賑山東。

translations.literal: He was ordered to supervise famine relief in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to supervise famine relief in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十七年，還京師。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣屢奉使命，所過州縣，間有藉差科派民財，深滋擾累。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Your subject has repeatedly received imperial commissions; in prefectures and districts passed through, there have sometimes been unlawful levies on the people's wealth under color of official missions, causing great harassment.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "I have repeatedly carried out imperial commissions, and in prefectures and districts along the way I have sometimes seen unlawful levies on the people's wealth under color of official business — a serious burden.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後有大事，特遣部院官，餘並責督撫料理。

translations.literal: I ask that hereafter, when there are major affairs, special envoys from the ministries and courts be dispatched; for all else, governors and governors-general should be charged with the handling.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereafter major affairs alone warrant special envoys from the ministries and courts; everything else should be left to governors and governors-general."

sentences.zh: 」上為下廷臣會議，定州縣科斂俱視貪吏治罪。

translations.literal: " The emperor referred it to court ministers for conference, and it was decided that district and prefectural exactions would be punished like those of corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the memorial to court ministers, who decided that district and prefectural exactions would be punished like those of corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 調吏部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 二十年，再遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he was again promoted to minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was again promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命察視石景山至盧溝橋石隄，疏言：「堤內本官地，康熙初招民墾荒，致侵損堤根。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he was ordered to inspect the stone dike from Shijingshan to Lugou Bridge; he memorialized: "Within the dike is originally government land; in the early Kangxi period people were recruited to open wasteland, damaging the foot of the dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to inspect the stone dike from Shijingshan to Lugou Bridge and wrote, "Land within the dike was originally government property; in early Kangxi settlers were recruited to open wasteland there, eroding the dike's base.

sentences.zh: 請敕部免其賦，罷勿復耕。

translations.literal: I ask that the ministry be instructed to remit its taxes and that cultivation cease and not resume.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry remit its taxes and forbid further cultivation."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，命察視山西地震，疏請被災最重州縣發帑治賑。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he was ordered to inspect the Shanxi earthquake; he memorialized requesting that the treasury be opened for relief in the hardest-hit prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was sent to inspect the Shanxi earthquake and memorialized that the treasury be opened for relief in the hardest-hit prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，河道總督靳輔請於高郵、寶應諸州縣築堤，束黃河注海，按察使於成龍主濬海口，下廷臣議，用輔策。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Yellow River director Jin Fu requested dikes be built in Gaoyou, Baoying, and other prefectures and districts to confine the Yellow River and direct it to the sea; surveillance commissioner Yu Chenglong advocated dredging the estuary; the matter was referred to court ministers, and Fu's plan was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Yellow River Director Jin Fu proposed building dikes in Gaoyou, Baoying, and other counties to confine the Yellow River and send it to the sea, while Surveillance Commissioner Yu Chenglong urged dredging the estuary; court ministers deliberated and adopted Fu's plan.

sentences.zh: 上詢日講官籍江南者，侍讀喬萊力請用成龍策。

translations.literal: The emperor asked Daily Lecture officials from Jiangnan; Reader-in-waiting Qiao Lai strongly urged Chenglong's plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Daily Lecture officials from Jiangnan, and Reader-in-Waiting Qiao Lai strongly pressed Chenglong's plan.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「鄉官議如此，未知民意如何？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Court officials from the region argue thus — but how do we know what the people think?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Home-province officials argue this way — but what do the people think?

sentences.zh: 」令薩穆哈與學士穆成額，會漕運總督徐旭齡、巡撫湯斌，詳察民間利害。

translations.literal: " He ordered Sa Muha and Academician Mu Cheng'e, together with Grain Transport Director-General Xu Xuling and Governor Tang Bin, to investigate the people's interests in detail.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Sa Muha and Academician Mu Cheng'e, together with Grain Transport Director-General Xu Xuling and Governor Tang Bin, to investigate the matter thoroughly among the people.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈等行歷海口諸州縣，諸州縣民陳狀參差不一；

translations.literal: Sa Muha and the others traveled through the estuary prefectures and districts; petitions from the people varied and were inconsistent;
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha and the others toured the estuary counties; petitions from the people were inconsistent;

sentences.zh: 檄諸州縣，令各擇通達事體者十人詢利害，皆言濬海口不便。

translations.literal: they issued orders to each prefecture and district to choose ten men versed in local affairs to consult on advantage and harm — all said dredging the estuary was impracticable.
translations.idiomatic: they ordered each county to choose ten knowledgeable locals to weigh costs and benefits — all said dredging the estuary was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，薩穆哈還奏，謂詳問居民，從成龍議；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Sa Muha returned and memorialized, saying that after detailed inquiry of residents, he favored Chenglong's proposal;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Sa Muha returned and reported that, after questioning residents in detail, he favored Chenglong's plan;

sentences.zh: 積水不能施工，從輔議；

translations.literal: but with accumulated water work could not proceed, so he favored Fu's proposal;
translations.idiomatic: with standing water, construction was impossible, so he also favored Fu's plan;

sentences.zh: 水中亦不能取土，請兩罷之。

translations.literal: earth could not be taken from the water either — he asked that both plans be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: and since earth could not be taken from the water, he asked that both be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 是時成龍召詣京師，上命廷臣及薩穆哈、成龍再議。

translations.literal: At this time Chenglong was summoned to the capital; the emperor ordered court ministers, Sa Muha, and Chenglong to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglong was then summoned to the capital, and the emperor ordered court ministers, Sa Muha, and Chenglong to debate the matter again.

sentences.zh: 成龍言濬海口當兼治串場河，費至百餘萬。

translations.literal: Chenglong said dredging the estuary must also treat the Chuan Chang River together, at a cost exceeding a million taels.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglong said dredging the estuary would also require treating the Chuan Chang River, at a cost of more than a million taels.

sentences.zh: 廷臣以為費鉅，疏請停。

translations.literal: Court ministers deemed the expense too great and memorialized to halt.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers judged the expense too great and memorialized to stop.

sentences.zh: 未幾，斌入為尚書，奏言：「海口不急濬，再遇水，下游諸州縣悉付巨浸。

translations.literal: Before long Bin entered the capital as minister and memorialized: "If the estuary is not dredged urgently, and floods come again, the downstream prefectures and districts will all be swallowed by vast inundation.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tang Bin entered the capital as minister and wrote, "If the estuary is not dredged soon and floods return, every downstream county will be drowned.

sentences.zh: 」上召問薩穆哈，薩穆哈不堅執前奏。

translations.literal: " The emperor summoned Sa Muha and questioned him; Sa Muha did not firmly uphold his earlier memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor summoned Sa Muha and questioned him; Sa Muha did not stand by his earlier report.

sentences.zh: 復下廷臣議，始定用成龍策。

translations.literal: The matter was again referred to court ministers, and Chenglong's plan was finally adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The matter went back to court ministers, and Chenglong's plan was finally adopted.

sentences.zh: 上責薩穆哈前覆奏不實，奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Sa Muha for his earlier reply being untrue and stripped him of his rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Sa Muha for his earlier reply and stripped him of rank.

sentences.zh: 尋授步軍翼尉。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed wing commander of the Metropolitan Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed wing commander of the Metropolitan Infantry.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，仍授工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, he was again appointed minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he was again appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，上察知工部積弊，河工糜帑，受請託，發​​銀多侵蝕，詰責薩穆哈等。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, the emperor discovered accumulated abuses in the Board of Works — river works squandered treasury funds, favors were solicited, and disbursed silver was largely embezzled — and rebuked Sa Muha and the others.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the emperor uncovered long-standing abuses in the Board of Works — river works wasting treasury funds, favors traded for bribes, disbursed silver largely stolen — and rebuked Sa Muha and the rest.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈尋以老疾乞罷，上斥其偽詐，命奪官，仍留任，察工部積弊，一一自列。

translations.literal: Sa Muha soon pleaded retirement on grounds of age and illness; the emperor denounced his deceit, ordered his rank stripped, yet kept him in office to investigate accumulated abuses in the Board of Works and list them one by one himself.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha soon asked to retire on grounds of age and illness; the emperor called him deceitful, stripped his rank, yet kept him in office to investigate the Board of Works' accumulated abuses and list every one himself.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，以疏濬京師內外河道侵蝕帑銀，薩穆哈得賕，逮治擬絞。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, because dredging rivers inside and outside the capital involved embezzling treasury silver, Sa Muha was found to have taken bribes; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, because dredging rivers inside and outside the capital involved embezzling treasury silver, Sa Muha was found to have taken bribes; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 卒於獄。

translations.literal: He died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: He died in prison.

sentences.zh: 論曰：米思翰贊撤籓之議，綢繆軍食，足以支十年，知定謀有由也。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Mi Sihan endorsed the policy of withdrawing the fiefs and carefully provisioned the army — enough to sustain ten years — showing that the settled plan had sound reasons.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Mi Sihan backed withdrawal of the fiefs and laid in army provisions enough for ten years — proof that the settled plan rested on solid grounds.

sentences.zh: 顧八代、瑪爾漢皆文臣，能克敵，復以廉勤建績。

translations.literal: Gu Badai and Ma Erhan were civil officials who could defeat the enemy, and built their records through integrity and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Badai and Ma Erhan were civil officials who could beat the enemy and built their reputations on integrity and hard work.

sentences.zh: 六善於軍事有建白，收綠旗之用，其效著於後矣。

translations.literal: Liushan had useful proposals on military affairs and drew Green Banner troops into effective service — the results were evident afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Liushan offered sound military counsel and put Green Banner troops to effective use — with results that showed later.

sentences.zh: 臻巡复海疆，兵後一大政也。

translations.literal: Zhen's tour restoring the maritime frontier was a major policy after the wars.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen's tour to restore the maritime frontier was a major postwar policy.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈以告變受賞，亦附著於斯篇。

translations.literal: Sa Muha was rewarded for reporting the mutiny and is therefore included in this chapter as well.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha was rewarded for reporting the mutiny and is therefore included here as well.
